annotations.title: Flights into and out of Boracay

description: List scheduled flights at Caticlan or Kalibo airport, with the time each runs on a given date (Philippine time). Use it to match a traveller's flight number to its landing or take off time.

date.description: Travel date, YYYY-MM-DD. Times can differ by day.

direction.description: arrival = landing at the airport, departure = flying out.

flight.description: Optional flight number to look for, e.g. 5J911 or PR2041.

name: find_boracay_flights
